Schematic section title saysESP32-H2-MINI-1, but actual U2 part and current overview identifyESP32-C6-MINI-1/4MiB. The exact part and overview are used; no H2 alias.

No native solid CAD found in retained scope. Published21×57.3mm XY and header spacing are preserved; body/component depths remain visibly UNKNOWN.
